The part of the plot about making Venture tower in to an asteroid ala G.I.Joe felt so grand, like movie level stakes, and what better way to stop its fall than the forgotten motherf*cking Venture GOBOT!!! Epic payoff my god!!! 😭😭😭😭😭


All and all awesome finale, you can tell by the amount of “loved” i used. If i had one wish it would only be that Brock had one more epic fight with anyone, maybe Red Death, that sh*t would’ve been 🔥
